## Details

<a id="shadow_facing0"></a>
### [`shadow_facing0`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing0.asm#L6) `$D540-$D7BF`

*data*

Floor shadow blocks for facing 0, shown directly as VIC pointers in the 4th sprite row at Y $da. Tables $33b7/$33c7/$33d7 give the pointers for the 8 air frames at $33af (10, 58, 9, 32, 21, 23, 22, 20).
Pointers $55-$5e: shadows of frames 32, 21, 23, 22 and 20.

<a id="figure_f67_parts"></a>
### [`figure_f67_parts`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing0.asm#L222) `$D7C0-$D87F`

*data*

Second set, parts $5f-$61: frame 67 of the small figure (standing, arms down). These numbers are no shadow pointers.

<a id="figure_hand_unused"></a>
### [`figure_hand_unused`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing0.asm#L288) `$D880-$D8BF`

*data*

Unused block (pointer $62): a hand or arm fragment. No shadow table and no frame names $62.

<a id="shadow_facing0_b"></a>
### [`shadow_facing0_b`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing0.asm#L295) `$D8C0-$D9FF`

*data*

Pointers $63-$67: shadows of frames 10 and 58 ($63-$65) and frame 9 ($66-$67), facing 0.
